verses.1: So, whether it’s the call to Christ, whether it’s a verse of love, whether it’s a fellowship with the Spirit, or whether it’s struggles and difficulties…
verses.2: Please repay me with joy, so that they may take care of it. With love in their hearts, they should work together to take care of it.
verses.3: Not out of arrogance or pride, but by respecting each other’s modesty and humility.
verses.4: Do not pursue their own interests alone, but also consider the interests of others as well.
verses.5: This, then, should be considered among you and in Christ Jesus.
verses.6: Whoever believes that the existence of God does not mean that God is perfect, has erred.
verses.7: But he transformed himself into the form of a slave, becoming human in appearance. He also had a human-like appearance.
verses.8: He became a servant of God, serving until his death; and his death happened at the time of the crucifixion.
verses.9: And therefore, the Lord also exalted him. He gave him a name that was more noble than any other name.
verses.10: That in the name of Jesus, all creatures of heaven and earth may be blessed.
verses.11: And all languages will acknowledge that Jesus Christ is truly the Son of God.
verses.12: So, my beloved ones, as always, do not act only in my presence, but also much more now when I am not there. With fear and trembling, strive for your own salvation.
verses.13: For God is the one who acts among you, and He also desires to act for your good.
verses.14: Always act without any doubts or considerations.
verses.15: So that you may become pure and innocent, children of God, amidst a generation full of sin and corruption. In this way, you will appear as lights in the world.
verses.16: Staying in life, I was brought to this day of Christ, because I didn’t go into emptiness, nor did I leave it empty.
verses.17: But even if I dedicate myself to the sacrifices and duties of your faith, I still rejoice and bless you all.
verses.18: And this same thing, you also rejoice in it, and share my joy with me.
verses.19: I hope that I can send you Timotheus, the Lord Jesus’ son, as soon as possible, so that I may be able to know what is happening with you.
verses.20: For I have no one who can be considered an equal to you in terms of knowledge about what relates to you.
verses.21: For all people seek only their own interests, not Jesus Christ.
verses.22: And you can test him by seeing that he served me and my son as a father and son in the cause of the gospel.
verses.23: So, I hope to send them now, as soon as I get to know about them myself.
verses.24: I also thought to myself that he would be dismissed quickly as well.
verses.25: I have therefore been forced to send Epaphroditus to you as my brother, collaborator, and soldier. He is also your apostle and servant in my mission.
verses.26: Because all of you were in danger, and because you heard that she was sick.
verses.27: And indeed, he died of a sudden death. But God pitied him; not only him, but also me, so that there would be no more sorrow upon us.
verses.28: I sent him away with great enthusiasm, so that they might see him again and be happy once more. I became even more miserable because of this.
verses.29: Therefore, accept him with all joy. And have those who deserve it among you.
verses.30: Because through the work of Christ, he endured death until his death. In doing so, he reminded the soul to fulfill its duty to serve others.
